answer: A fresh key stakes 400 POA as a basalt-hard bond inside the common harbor escrow on join. Each epoch it must emit a unique plume of 40 POA burned as proof gas plus a seeded challenge response; the harbor holds the bond for ten clean epochs and returns it only after continuous attestation. Shared funding roots make the plume cost double for every sibling key, and a failed audit burns the whole cluster bond. An attacker pays more than 800 POA per fake identity before any payout, with no free riding on others history.
